object.attr: as implemented: STATUS.md: a three-way merge of each document file both sides changed. git's conflict markers lose a document's structure, and starting from the commits each time lets the user resolve again with other choices. Split from "each merged document file" (review Q10).
object.description: When Mellon resolves a merge, Mellon shall compute each file in a document folder that both sides changed from the merge base, ours and theirs, not from the working copy.
